note: design-sync: all components marked with // design-sync header. Single source of truth for the Survivor Hub mockup deck.

components.name: Desktop
components.notes: Hub home — icon rail + #community channel + right rail. AI chat as primary interaction.

components.name: HubPublic
components.notes: Public-facing Hub view. #community channel is publicly readable. No blur/lock. Locked composer at bottom.

components.name: HubEmpty
components.notes: Hub #community empty state. Invite-only, survivor-verified messaging.

components.name: MobileHome
components.notes: Hub mobile home. #community blended stream + apps tab. 17 apps (Feed/Announcements absorbed into Hub #community).

components.name: MobileHubPublic
components.notes: Public mobile Hub #community view. Blended stream, no blur. Locked composer + join CTA.

components.name: AIConsent
components.notes: First-use AI Assistant consent prompt over the composer. Self-hosted AI, no third parties. Confirm / Not now.

components.name: MobileAIConsent
components.notes: Mobile first-use AI Assistant consent bottom sheet. Self-hosted AI, no third parties. Confirm / Not now.

components.name: AIReviewConsole
components.notes: Owner Review & Correction Console. Queue of AI drafts w/ question, draft, sources, confidence. Approve / Edit&approve / Reject.

components.name: AIReviewConsoleDetail
components.notes: Single AI draft review w/ editable corrected-text field.

components.name: AIReviewConsoleEmpty
components.notes: Review queue clear / nothing pending.

components.name: MobileAIReviewConsole
components.notes: Mobile Owner Review & Correction Console. Queue of AI drafts. Approve / Edit&approve / Reject.

components.name: MobileAIReviewConsoleDetail
components.notes: Mobile single AI draft review w/ editable corrected-text field.

components.name: WhatWorks
components.notes: One shared, survivor-verified curated list of tools/products organized by problem. Benable-style lists meets the 'Look Ma, I Fixed It' problems page. No ads, no affiliates.

components.name: WhatWorksEmpty
components.notes: Add-item / suggest form (admins + members): problem / product / link / why, with success state. Problem is chosen from a pre-existing list; only admins create new problems (avoids duplicates). No prices. Same page reused if per-survivor published lists ship later.

components.name: MobileWhatWorksEmpty
components.notes: Mobile add-item / suggest form (admins + members). Problem chosen from a pre-existing list; only admins create new problems. No prices.

components.name: GDPRateAdmin
components.notes: Admin-only currency USD-rate management screen (inside admin hub). Lists currencies with active usd_rate/as_of/source. Revise action creates a new dated row; prior values shown as history. Calm disclaimer: factors only estimate GDP, never a redemption/per-wallet value. LEGAL: never show 'N ServiceCredits ≈ $X' for any user-facing or per-wallet figure.

components.name: MobileGDPRateAdmin
components.notes: Mobile admin-only currency USD-rate management. Same guardrails as GDPRateAdmin.

components.name: AccountData
components.notes: Personal data inventory across all 19 deletable services + 2 always-retained (ServiceCredits, GDP). Per-service delete queuing + Danger Zone full-account deletion path.

components.name: AccountDataEmpty
components.notes: New account — no activity recorded yet across any service.

components.name: AccountDataConfirmDelete
components.notes: Most critical screen. Calm trauma-informed language. Type-to-confirm gesture ('delete my account'). Lists what's deleted vs retained. ServiceCredits settled via standard process — not destroyed. Audit records retained by design. Success acknowledgement state.

components.name: MobileAccountData
components.notes: Mobile data inventory. Tab bar: Your Data | Danger Zone. Per-service delete queuing.

components.name: MobileAccountDataConfirmDelete
components.notes: Mobile full-account deletion confirmation. Type-to-confirm gesture. Lists deleted vs retained. ServiceCredits settled via standard process. Success state.

channel_model.name: community
channel_model.notes: Single blended stream. No multi-channel sidebar. No separate Feed/Announcements app tile.

app_count.note: Feed/Announcements absorbed into Hub homepage (#community channel). Not a separate app tile.
